# OW003: 畅春园 Changchun Yuan

a neighbouring imperial or princely garden · outside the walls · confidence A, assumed

**3D object:** none yet.

## What we know

- **Name:** 畅春园 Changchun Yuan (S05, S02, S1200, S1202, S1207, S1214, S23, S685 · confidence A)
- **In English:** Garden of Joyful Spring (Kangxi's garden; not our 长春园) (S05, S02, S1200, S1202, S1207, S1214, S23, S685)
- **What it was:** a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls (S05, S02, S1200, S1202, S1207, S1214, S23, S685 · confidence A)
- **In 1860:** decayed by the Daoguang reign; from 1843 a subsidiary garden; its NW part taken into 承泽园 1845; in 1856 (Xianfeng 6) many buildings pulled down for their timber (S685, table 1); 清溪书屋, 恩佑寺, 恩慕寺 burned Oct 1860 (明善's memorial via S1207); levelled 1909 as a drill ground (S02 p.215) (S05, S02, S1200, S1202, S1207, S1214, S23, S685)
- **Size:** wall 1,060 zhang, about 3,390 m round (S05 j76; S02 p.21 '10,600 Chinese feet'); polygon 65.6 ha, 3,399 m (run); zh.wiki 1000 x 600 m, 60 ha (S1200, lead) (S05, S02, S1200, S1202, S1207, S1214, S23, S685)
- **Where:** geo polygon, C: Song 2021 Fig. 5 wall line (S685, CC BY 4.0), anchored on the 恩佑寺 gate (osm way 169215123), scaled to the 1,060-zhang wall of S05 j76 (S05, S02, S1200, S1202, S1207, S1214, S23, S685 · confidence C)
- **Note:** S05 j76: 在南海淀大河庄之北; 因在圆明园之南亦名前园. Gate of five bays with east and west 朝房, a stream round it (j76); Malone puts the gate in the middle of the south side (p.22), zh.wiki on the south wall's east side (disagreement). Inside: 九经三事殿, 春晖堂, 寿萱春永 (the empress dowager's), 前湖 and 后湖, the 丁香堤, 兰芝堤, 桃花堤, 清溪书屋 (Kangxi died there 1722), 无逸斋 by the west wall with vegetable plots and rice fields inside (j76); boat dock outside the south wall (j76; S02 p.103). The best outline lead: Malone's sketch map p.23 from Wen Chi-ju's manuscript map (S23, research-only) and Song 2021 (S685, CC BY). Survivors: the 恩佑寺 and 恩慕寺 gates and the NE boundary stele (S1202).; Picture lead: the 1717 birthday procession woodblocks show the gate and bell tower (S02 p.104; S1214, leaf not located).; Malone's sketch p.22 (S23) puts the gate with shadow walls in the middle of the south side, 恩慕寺 and 恩佑寺 inside the east wall's north part, the bell tower by the SE corner and the 火神庙 across the road; its shape is about 1.33 : 1 (N-S : E-W), i.e. about 970 x 730 m: disagreement with the C polygon (880 x 760 m) and zh.wiki (1000 x 600 m).; Song 2021 (S685, CC BY 4.0, read this round): the two temple gates stand on the east wall near its NE corner; the 恩佑寺 gate is turned about 12 degrees from the 恩慕寺 gate, so the east wall is not straight; the south wall from the archaeological plan of the 大宫门 site; the imperial road is today's 颐和园路. His Fig. 5 scale bar gives about 750 x 1,200-1,400 m (4.1 km round), against the 3,390 m of j76: scaled down here (disagreement). Our polygon then puts the SE corner about 160 m south of the 火神庙 (Malone p.21 puts it at the road in front of that temple). (S05, S02, S1200, S1202, S1207, S1214, S23, S685)
